notes.title: Patch v1.1: Upgrade & Fixes + Achievements + Cloud Save
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43512659/942c316377d4d97246299ffd6f67ccb0ab42315f.jpg
Hello everyone,

We recently did an update of the game without publishing the patch note and we are doing a second one to fix some issues. We are also improving some elements of the game.
All modifications for both patch are here: 

- Five achievements have been added to the game. One for each girl if you want to display them on your profile. If you already finished the game before they were added. Start a new game, press SKIP/AUTO in full speed (settings) and you will unlock them in 30seconds.
- We received a lot of feedback to change some sentences but also some typos in the forum, in the review and on Discord. They are now all cleared! If you find new ones after the patch, please report them to us and we will fix them! Discord: discord.gg/SUp8drcewR
- We reworked a little how the gallery was working especially for people with different resolution than 16/9 and 16/10.
- CG#3 (Kaya on the bed) has been reworked a little to fix some lighting issues.
- Cloud saves are now enabled.
- Zylyx logo has been added on the main menu.

I probably forget a thing or two but don't hesitate to restart the game to unlock the achievements and add a 100% game to your list :)

Did you see that we released a new #VISUALNOVEL game on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2732730/Tomboy_Love_in_Hot_Forge/
